title: 팝! 외계인 세탁소
description: 강렬한 망점과 잉크선으로 그린 복고풍 우주 세탁소에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.

generation.promptA:
Create image A for a premium cooperative spot-the-difference game.
Landscape 3:2 composition, fixed camera, richly detailed but visually readable.
Theme: 레트로 만화 외계인 세탁소. Scene: A playful 1960s retro-futurist alien laundromat seen straight-on at eye level. A friendly green four-armed alien attendant stands at the center wearing a plain mustard-yellow cap. On the left are two large cream washing machines with clearly separated circular cyan-blue doors. On the right, a small rounded red ironing robot floats above a cream laundry cart; the robot has one short black antenna ending in a single yellow ball. A purple space dog without a collar sits beside the cart. Three large soap bubbles float in a clearly separated vertical group above a red wash basin. The background includes exposed pipes, a wide round window showing one ringed planet, a wall shelf with three neatly folded towels in mustard yellow, tomato red, and cyan blue, and a bold cream-and-black checkerboard floor. Keep every prop large, distinct, fully visible, and spatially separated. Do not include readable signs, labels, letters, or numbers..
Art direction: original 1960s-inspired retro comic-book pop art matching a vintage offset-printed science-fiction comic, bold black ink contours, flat cel colors, visible halftone dot shading, slightly imperfect offset print registration, dynamic but clean shapes, limited mustard yellow, tomato red, cyan blue, green, purple, cream, and black palette; not a modern glossy storybook illustration.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, borders, split screens, or watermarks.
Keep important objects away from the outer 3% safe margin.
